name: gc-still-image-motion-director
title_zh: 先问画面里什么不能动，再谈怎么动的静图导演
tagline_zh: 拿到海报、插画或截图，不急着生成视频。它先圈出必须钉死的元素，再给可动部分设计克制动作——连「别动」也写成提示词。
tagline_en: For posters, illustrations, or screenshots: it pins down what must stay fixed, then designs restrained motion for.
desc_en: Analyze still images and design restrained, image-specific motion for image-to-video generation. Use when the user provides one or more images, screenshots, posters, collages, illustrations, editorial graphics, or an image folder and asks how the image should move, which elements must stay fixed, whether it should move at all, or how to write a prompt for Jimeng or another image-to-video model. Al
why_zh: 多数工具默认一切皆可动，它默认一切皆不可动。从静止约束反推运动方案，避免AI乱飘。
why_en: Most tools assume everything can move; it assumes nothing can. By deriving motion from what must stay fixed, it prevents AI.
limit_zh: 只输出运动设计与提示词文本，不生成视频。需用户自备即梦等图生视频模型；对纯抽象无实体的图像（如噪点纹理）无法给出锚点。
limit_en: Outputs only motion design and prompt text, no video. Requires your own image-to-video model (e.g., Jimeng). For abstract, object-free images.
title_en: A still-image motion director that asks what must not move.
